svg.text: Wand power rails: THREE rails at 30° / 150° / 270°, the same board built three times
Wand power rails: THREE rails at 30° / 150° / 270°, the same board built three times
Each board: BusBoard ST1, 6 strips × 20 columns (17 × 50 mm as cut), one net per strip, no dead strip, no track cuts, no link wires. Copper side shown.
Each board: BusBoard ST1, 6 strips × 20 columns (17 × 50 mm as cut), one net per strip, no dead strip, no track cuts, no link wires. Copper side shown.
Each rail feeds the 4 drivers beside it. Power arrives on PWR IN from the cradle board (a star: one pigtail per rail). Logic arrives on rail 30 only.
Each rail feeds the 4 drivers beside it. Power arrives on PWR IN from the cradle board (a star: one pigtail per rail). Logic arrives on rail 30 only.
NO berg: leads soldered straight into the strip holes
NO berg: leads soldered straight into the strip holes
Cols 7-10: one 2-pin landing per driver (13.8 V + GND-power), the driver's Dupont plugs onto its column. Seats named by angle and row (Lo / Hi), as in 10.5.9.
Cols 7-10: one 2-pin landing per driver (13.8 V + GND-power), the driver's Dupont plugs onto its column. Seats named by angle and row (Lo / Hi), as in 10.5.9.
Rail 30° carries everything that is not a driver: SIG IN (the only logic pigtail), FAN, PCA and TMP. Rails 150° and 270° carry only their 4 drivers and PWR IN.
Rail 30° carries everything that is not a driver: SIG IN (the only logic pigtail), FAN, PCA and TMP. Rails 150° and 270° carry only their 4 drivers and PWR IN.
Solder on the COPPER (outer, wall-facing) face; connector bodies on the bare inner face. Rail 270° has no berg because berg plugs foul the PCA9685's −Y edge.
Solder on the COPPER (outer, wall-facing) face; connector bodies on the bare inner face. Rail 270° has no berg because berg plugs foul the PCA9685's −Y edge.
M2 holes at cols 4 and 17, centred BETWEEN strips 3 and 4 (the posts sit on the gap centreline): each Ø2.2 hole trims both strip edges but cuts neither. No solder in cols 3-5 / 16-18.
M2 holes at cols 4 and 17, centred BETWEEN strips 3 and 4 (the posts sit on the gap centreline): each Ø2.2 hole trims both strip edges but cuts neither. No solder in cols 3-5 / 16-18.
